title: admitted_launch_envelope.v1 (provisional)
description: What a harness receives after admission. Harness-neutral and language-neutral. Every digest is lowercase hex SHA-256. The harness treats assignment_digest, snapshot_ref, crosswalk_ref, obligation digests and caller_context as opaque. Field types, required fields and closed enums are defined here; the semantic rules a schema cannot establish are listed under x-semantic-rules. Status: provisional until the owning contract revision completes; a change needs reconciliation with every consumer.

envelope_digest.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of this object with envelope_digest removed.

crosswalk_ref.description: Opaque reference to the reviewed correspondence of the subject project at the snapshot; identifies the project.

caller_context.description: Opaque. Echoed back byte-for-byte (JCS) in every record that carries it; never interpreted by the harness or the workbench reader.

x-canonicalization: RFC 8785 (JCS). Vectors use ASCII object keys and integers only, so code-point and UTF-16 key orders coincide.

provider_readonly_patch_return_audit.limits: The provider is asked to run read-only; that is the provider's own enforcement, not operating-system confinement. Changes return as proposal bytes that are checked before apply, followed by a post-run audit. A tool-action refusal is detection, not prevention. Network cannot be denied. A same-login process is not contained.

post_write_audit_only.limits: Detects after the write only. Applies when the workspace is not a separate clone or copy, for example a git worktree of the protected repository, which shares its object store and refs.

os_enforced.limits: Reserved and unqualified. An envelope that requires it is refused.

x-semantic-rules.envelope_digest_mismatch: envelope_digest does not equal the JCS SHA-256 of the envelope without envelope_digest.
x-semantic-rules.authority_foreign: assignment_digest or units.crosswalk_ref differs from the injected validator's independently expected values (another assignment, repository or project), even when the envelope self-verifies.
x-semantic-rules.authority_baseline_stale: units.snapshot_ref differs from the independently expected snapshot while assignment and crosswalk match, even when the envelope self-verifies.
x-semantic-rules.tier_unqualified: the tier is reserved or unqualified.
x-semantic-rules.constraint_unsupported: a required constraint maps to not_enforced under the declared tier; refused with {constraint, tier}, never silently weakened.
x-semantic-rules.workspace_not_separate_copy: the workspace kind is not permitted for the declared tier.
x-semantic-rules.locator_not_repo_relative: a locator is empty, absolute, contains a '..' segment or a backslash.
x-semantic-rules.dependency_digest_required: executable dependencies are declared without an admitted dependency digest.
x-semantic-rules.raw_output_in_record: a string outside caller_context contains a line break or control character, or exceeds 512 characters.
x-semantic-rules.caller_context_interpreted: an echoed caller_context differs from the envelope's caller_context.
x-semantic-rules.refusal_zero_invocations: every refusal above is recorded before any process starts, as state refused with worker_invocations 0.
